hero.description: Alvor Healthcare Company Limited imports, markets, and distributes pharmaceutical products, medical supplies, and healthcare products for pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, healthcare professionals, and communities across Myanmar.

mission.title: Mission, Vision & Values
mission.description: Quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction guide how we support healthcare providers and communities.
mission.valuesSummary: Quality, integrity, reliability, partnership, and innovation guide our relationships and daily work.

coreValues.title: Quality
coreValues.description: Committed to delivering healthcare products that meet quality standards.

coreValues.title: Integrity
coreValues.description: Building trust through ethical business practices.

coreValues.title: Reliability
coreValues.description: Providing consistent supply and dependable service.

coreValues.title: Partnership
coreValues.description: Working closely with healthcare providers and international partners.

coreValues.title: Innovation
coreValues.description: Continuously improving healthcare solutions and services.

history.title: Our Journey
history.description: From our founding to today, each milestone marks our commitment to improving healthcare access in Myanmar.

milestones.title: Founded
milestones.description: Alvor Healthcare was established to improve access to quality healthcare products in Myanmar.

milestones.title: Strategic Partnerships
milestones.description: Expanded our network of international pharmaceutical manufacturers.

milestones.title: National Distribution
milestones.description: Built a nationwide distribution network reaching hospitals and pharmacies across Myanmar.

milestones.title: Community Impact
milestones.description: Supporting healthcare providers and communities with reliable access to medical supplies.

services.title: Healthcare supply built for Myanmar
services.description: Through international manufacturer partnerships and an established distribution network, we support healthcare providers with products, information, and dependable service.

items.title: Importation
items.description: We source and import pharmaceutical products and healthcare supplies from trusted international manufacturers while supporting applicable local regulatory requirements.

items.title: Distribution
items.description: We distribute healthcare products to pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, and healthcare organizations across Myanmar.

items.title: Marketing & Sales
items.description: Our team provides product marketing, healthcare education, and professional support for healthcare providers.

items.title: Healthcare Solutions
items.description: We provide pharmaceutical products, medical supplies, diagnostic products, and consumer healthcare products for professional and community needs.
